question: Should OpenClaw accept this stacked signed marketplace feed trust model and CLI trust-state exposure once the prerequisite verifier, config, and refresh-state PRs are landed or rebased cleanly?
rationale: The patch is not only display code on the actual merge result: it carries local trust-root config, fail-closed signed profiles, signed envelope verification, persisted trust state, and security-boundary diagnostics that require maintainer intent.

options.title: Land after stack cleanup
options.body: Resolve the prerequisite PR order and dirty merge state, refresh exact-head approval, and keep the bounded CLI trust output as proposed.

options.title: Replay CLI-only later
options.body: Wait for the verifier, config, and refresh slices to merge first, then replay only the CLI visibility commit on top of main.

options.title: Pause trust rollout
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers choose a different signed-feed trust-root or default-feed policy.

recommendation.title: Land after stack cleanup
recommendation.body: Resolve the prerequisite PR order and dirty merge state, refresh exact-head approval, and keep the bounded CLI trust output as proposed.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and prior exact-SHA reviewer for this stacked trust series, so they are the best available owner for the merge-direction decision.
